plot: On her last afternoon in Wheelburg, Grandma Rosa wants one lap on the round race track by the big oak where she won race number seven, but nobody has ever seen a track; Turbo searches the town and blows the park's leaves everywhere, then Bolt notices her old trophy says 'Oak Ring' and the park's round walking path is called the Doughnut Path — the old track is still there under Grumpy's autumn leaf piles; the whole town sweeps it together, Rosa wins one last lap because Turbo stops to wave, and as she drives home at sunset, Turbo's tyre goes flat.

script.title: Where Did Grandma's Race Track Go?
script.description: Grandma Rosa won her first race in Wheelburg. Now the track is gone. Inspector Bolt #30

set.place: Wheelburg Park by the big old oak and its round leafy path, Grandma Rosa's last afternoon until sunset

beats.say: Race track! Where are you? Come out, race track!
I looked everywhere! The school, the bakery, the car wash!
But it was here. By the big oak. I'm sure of it.
It was Grandma Rosa's last afternoon in Wheelburg.
At sunset she would drive home to the seaside.
Grandma just wants one lap. One lap on her old track.
Race number seven. My very first win. Right here, under the oak.
The track was round, like a big doughnut. Sandy and bumpy.
Like the Doughnut Path? Where Grumpy rakes the leaves?
That's just a path. For walking. And for my leaves.
A path is not a track! Tracks have lines and finishes!
Hmm. Madam Rosa, what do you remember from that day?
They gave me a little gold cup. I keep it always.
She showed them a tiny golden trophy with a seven on it.
Grandma, you carried it all the way here?
Of course, dear. It's my lucky cup.
Okay! New plan! I'll find the track at top speed!
Turbo zoomed across the park. Around and around the oak.
Whoosh! Leaves flew up everywhere. Red, yellow and brown.
My leaves. My neat leaf piles.
I raked those all morning. Every single one.
Sorry, Grumpy! But look! Still no track! Only more leaves!
Turbo, you made a leaf storm! I can't see my wheels!
I just wanted to help Grandma. I always go too fast.
Oh, Turbo dear. I went too fast too, when I was young.
The sun is going down. Grandma leaves in one hour!
If we don't find it, she'll never race here again!
Let us not rush. Let us look at the clue we have.
Bolt looked closely at the little gold trophy.
There are tiny words under the seven. Oak Ring.
Oak Ring! Yes! That's what we called it!
Oak Ring? Nobody in Wheelburg calls anything that.
Names change, Bertha. Places often stay.
Grumpy. Your Doughnut Path. What is under the leaves?
Sand. Bumps. Old white stones. Very annoying for raking.
And where do you put all the leaves each autumn?
On the path. In a big ring. Around the oak.
The Doughnut Path IS the race track?!
It was never gone! It was just sleeping under leaves!
But look at all those leaves. And the sun is so low.
The sun is touching the hills! We need everyone, right now!
So everyone lined up, side by side, like a big broom.
Push together. Nice and steady. Nobody zooms.
Nobody zooms? Not even a tiny zoom?
Not even a tiny zoom.
They rolled forward together. Swish, swish, swish.
Leaves on my roof! Leaves in my windows! I'm a leaf bus!
Grumpy, your hook is full of leaves! You look like a tree!
I am a tree now. A grumpy tree.
And under the leaves, old white lines began to appear.
There it is. My Oak Ring. Just like I remember.
Grandma, look! The finish line is still there!
Some old things aren't gone. They're just waiting under the leaves.
One lap! Grandma Rosa versus Turbo! Pretty please?
Oh, you're on, young car!
Ready, steady, go! They raced around the big old oak.
Look at me! Look how fast I am! Hello, everyone!
Turbo turned to wave at his friends. Again. And again.
And Grandma Rosa just kept going. Steady. Never stopping.
What? How? I'm the fastest car in Wheelburg!
Fast is good, dear. But you have to keep looking ahead.
Race number eight! Grandma won again!
Okay, okay. You are the real champion, Grandma Rosa.
Heh. Good race. Bad for my leaves.
Then it was time for Grandma Rosa to drive home.
Do you really have to go? We just found your track!
I'll come back in spring, sweetie. For race number nine.
Pip, dear, keep this. For your first race one day.
She gave Pip the little gold trophy.
I'll keep it safe, Grandma. I promise. Always.
Bye-bye, Wheelburg! Bye-bye, my Oak Ring!
The friends watched her purple lights go over the hill.
Okay! Now I'll practise! Around the track, ten times!
He zoomed off toward the old white stones. Bump, bump, bump.
Pfffffft.
My front tyre. It's flat. Totally flat.
Old white stones. Sharp ones. I told you.
A new tyre can't come until tomorrow, Turbo.
Tomorrow? A whole day without zooming? I can't!
What do you think Bolt will find next time? We'll find out in the next episode!

"I won my very first race right here. So where did my track go?" — Grandma Rosa
